claims.text: Vdara is a casino-free, smoke-free spa resort on the Las Vegas Strip.

findings.quote: Vdara delivers a relaxing and unique take on Las Vegas vacations as a casino-free, smoke-free spa resort situated on the strip.

claims.text: Vdara sits in the CityCenter complex between Bellagio and Aria, set slightly back from Las Vegas Boulevard.

findings.quote: In the CityCenter complex between Bellagio and Aria, set slightly back from
Boulevard with walkway connections to both.

claims.text: Vdara opened in 2009 as part of CityCenter, conceived from the start as a condo-hotel hybrid.

findings.quote: Vdara opened in 2009 as part of CityCenter, conceived from the start as a condo-hotel hybrid

claims.text: Every room at Vdara is a suite.

findings.quote: Every room at Vdara is a suite, which changes the whole feel of a stay here.

claims.text: Standard studios come with a sitting area, a dining table and a kitchenette with a cooktop, microwave, sink and refrigerator.

findings.quote: Even standard studios start around 500–600 square feet and come with a sitting area, dining table, and kitchenette equipped with a cooktop, microwave, sink, and empty refrigerator you can actually stock yourself.

claims.text: The look is modern and somewhat understated, more sleek condo than themed resort.

findings.quote: The overall look is modern and somewhat understated—more sleek condo than themed resort

claims.text: The naturally lit fitness center has cardio equipment with personal entertainment centers, weight machines and free weights.

findings.quote: Make yourself comfortable in our naturally lit Fitness Center, featuring a variety of state-of-the-art cardio equipment, each outfitted with personal entertainment centers, as well as weight machines, free weights

claims.text: Pedestrian paths and interior walkways connect Vdara to Aria, Bellagio and the wider CityCenter complex, including the Shops at Crystals.

findings.quote: Pedestrian paths and interior walkways connect you to Aria’s casino and restaurants, Bellagio’s casino and fountains, and the larger CityCenter complex, including the Shops at Crystals.

claims.text: T-Mobile Arena and Park MGM are an easy walk away for concerts and games.

findings.quote: It is an easy walk to T-Mobile Arena and Park MGM for concerts and games

claims.text: Market Café Vdara handles quick breakfasts, salads, sandwiches and grab-and-go meals, plus groceries.

findings.quote: Market Café Vdara handles quick breakfasts, salads, sandwiches, and grab-and-go meals, plus groceries and frozen items you can heat up in your kitchenette.

claims.text: VICE VERSA Patio & Lounge is the hotel's main bar and social space, with indoor-outdoor seating.

findings.quote: Vice Versa Patio & Lounge functions as the main bar and social space, with indoor-outdoor seating

claims.text: Vdara is part of MGM Rewards.

findings.quote: Part of MGM Rewards through its connection with Aria and CityCenter

claims.text: The Spa at Vdara is spread across two floors, with European-style heat experiences, quiet relaxation areas and ESPA-branded treatments.

findings.quote: The Spa at Vdara is one of the resort’s signatures, spread across two floors with European-style heat experiences, quiet relaxation areas, and ESPA-branded treatments

claims.text: Vdara Pool & Cabanas has private retreats and cabanas with semi-secluded plunge pools.

findings.quote: Surrounded by cutting-edge design, private retreats and cabanas with semi-secluded plunge pools, Vdara Pool & Cabanas offers blissful escape.

claims.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the mountains, CityCenter or, in fountain view layouts, the Bellagio Fountains.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the mountains, CityCenter, or, in specific “fountain view” layouts, the Bellagio Fountains across the way.

claims.text: Larger suite categories add full kitchens and often in-suite washer-dryers, which make longer trips or work stays easier.

findings.quote: add more square footage, full kitchens, and often in-suite washer–dryer setups that make longer trips or work stays much easier

claims.text: The pool deck is far more relaxed than the party scenes at many nearby properties, with no DJ-driven dayclub.

findings.quote: significantly more relaxed than the party scenes at many nearby properties, with cabanas and semi-private plunge areas rather than a DJ-driven dayclub

claims.text: There is no casino at Vdara; guests walk over to Aria or Bellagio to play.

findings.quote: casino-free, smoke-free spa resort
Pedestrian paths and interior walkways connect you to Aria’s casino and restaurants, Bellagio’s casino and fountains

claims.text: Vdara works well for families who value space and kitchenettes, but there is no dedicated kid zone.

findings.quote: Works well for longer stays and families who value space and kitchenettes, though there is no dedicated kid zone

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a higher price point than traditional hotel rooms.
